[[File:Scout's Sentry.png|thumb]]
The '''Scout's Sentry''' is an exclusive Attack Module.

== Description ==
''With knowledge of your weaknesses and the agility to strike first, Scout Bots eliminates opponents without recourse.''

== Stats ==

* 3-Star
** Health: 2,776
** Attack: 242
** Rating: 446
* 4-Star (Rank 3/30)
** Health: 5,965
** Attack: 519
** Rating: 996

== Abilities ==
===Basic Abilities===
*Enhanced Evade
*Enhanced Critical Buffs
*Power Gain
===Abilities===
*''Passive:''
**Evades are 20~40% more likely and Evade Buffs last 20~60% longer.
**Critical Chance Buffs are 25~45% stronger and last 20~60% longer.
*''On Evade:'' Inflict Power Lock for 3 seconds.
*''On Critical Hit:'' Instantly gain 2~12% power.

===Signature Ability===
'''Exhaustion'''

''Evades from the Defender cause the Attacker to suffer from deadly exhaustion.''

While Opponent is Power Locked: Attacker loses health equal to 3~10% of their Attack Rating for as long as they are Power Locked.
{| class="article-table"

== Strategy ==
Evasive Scouts like [[Sideswipe]] and [[Bumblebee]] will deal more critical hits, gain more power and evade more consistently denying power from the attacker. You’ll want to avoid pairing this module with Bots that don't evade well/often or that don't make use of Critical Hit Rate Buffs.

== Obtainment ==
* the 3~4 Star Mod can be found in the Exclusive Mod Crystal.

== Gallery ==
<gallery>
Scout's Sentry Icon.jpg
</gallery>

==Notes==

* The mod was introduced in November 2017, and of one two Class-boosting Mods.
